initial_decision.brief_rationale: The verified arithmetic contrast does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R138-2 to assess whether the assignment mechanism and the role of Z identify the requested average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R138-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Standardization over the population’s equally weighted Z strata identifies the causal risk difference: 0.5(9/10 − 36/40) + 0.5(6/10 − 32/40) = −0.10.
